message.content: Which of our stateful object classes have instances that currently hold stored data?

content.text:
I could not answer this from the repo. The tools I have cannot read files or search code, so I did not see any of our stateful classes or their storage code. The only Cloudflare tool that could report stored data, `durableObjects_namespaces_objects_list`, is a dry run here: it returned the request it would send to `/accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces/demo-namespace/objects` and sent nothing, so it returned no data.

To get the answer, point me at the repo in a session where I can read files, or run the Durable Objects check against the real account. In the repo, search for classes that extend `DurableObject` and for `ctx.storage` or `storage.sql` calls. Then check each class's storage for rows or keys. I did not run either of those, so I have no list of classes or instances to report.
